summary: GEMSDOE32's index page labels gems32-probe-S1-ANCHOR-identical-to-live-02600.tif as a 0.2708 anchor, but its own audit calls the same digest the 0.2600 reference anchor, and the mask is byte-identical to the GEMSDOE25 0.2600 artifact.

summary: The three geodetic layers satisfy no exact algebraic identity, so the invariant convention behind geod_2ndinv is not recoverable.
evidence: Tested on 5,164,312 in-footprint pixels: sqrt(dil^2+shear^2) max |error| 33.8 on a field with median 19.9 (best r = 0.9934); sqrt((dil^2+shear^2)/2), sqrt(dil^2+2 shear^2), |dil|+|shear| all worse. geod_2ndinv >= |shear| holds everywhere but geod_2ndinv >= |dil| holds only 82% of the time.
status: OPEN - Stage 1 is stated in quantile space, which is invariant to the unknown convention.

summary: Any feature derived from the catalogue is a perfect training leak in a blocked holdout.
evidence: With d_cat and cat_dens in the feature matrix, in-block AUC was exactly 0.500 while the physical features alone reach 0.63; removing them recovered in-block AUC to 0.667. Cause: every training positive is itself a catalogue pixel, so d_cat == 0 for all positives and > 0 for all negatives.
status: CLOSED - catalogue-derived columns excluded from the model, used only at emission time.

summary: The provenance of the hidden test faults is deliberately undisclosed, so no competitor can tell whether the labels are topographic, geophysical or field-mapped. Phase 2's test set is rebuilt from expert review of Phase 1 submissions.
evidence: chrisk-dd, 2026-09-23, community thread 11527 post 7: "We're not sharing details about the data sources, fault types, or coverage behind the test faults beyond what's in the problem description." And: "the largest prize pool (Phase 2) will use a test set that is updated by expert review of all Phase 1 submissions, so your fault predictions have an impact on final evaluation even if they are not the most performant in Phase 1."
status: RESOLVED - no answer will come. Consequence: (a) every validation instrument here is calibrated against the visible catalogue and may not match the hidden label style; (b) Phase 1 submissions are not free - they are inputs to Phase 2's test set, so geological defensibility of the emitted dots matters beyond this round's score.

summary: The footprint contains 3,073 cells where at least one of the 19 competition bands is the sentinel, so a pixel classifier cannot score them.
status: CLOSED - those cells are excluded from emission; the submission still writes a finite value there (0.0) so the portal range check passes.

summary: Two independent implementations of the same library occupy the same paths in this repository's history (PR #1/#2 from an earlier session, and this session's). They were developed in parallel on separate branches and are not API-compatible.
evidence: 27 paths conflicted add/add on merge: src/gems51/{__init__,detector,emission,features,grid,holdout,metric,submission}.py, scripts/{build_site,prepare_data,run_holdout}.py, tests/test_metric.py, registry/{data_manifest,hypotheses,irregularities,sources}.json, docs/*.html, README.md, .gitignore, data/restore_receipt.json.
status: RESOLVED NON-DESTRUCTIVELY - this session's versions were kept for the shared code and site paths, because they are what produced the shipped artifacts. Every conflicting file from PR #1/#2 is preserved verbatim under attic/pr1-2/, and all 74 non-conflicting files (evidence/*.json, docs/claims.html, docs/strategy.html, docs/executive-summary.html, docs/assets/, .github/workflows/, data/labels.tif, data/existing_faults.tif, data/sample_submission.tif, index.html, pyproject.toml, requirements.txt) are carried through untouched.

summary: The file this project has been calling the training labels is byte-identical to the known-fault raster. The competition's true training labels have therefore never been available to any GEMSDOE session, and every model here is trained against the visible catalogue as a proxy.
evidence: data/labels.tif and data/existing_faults.tif both have sha256 7ba308ccdc4418b31a178f4f1ef21aaa6e152e4028f2f6f64b01f7eb25ae4093 and 425,830 bytes; np.array_equal on the rasters is True. Their positive mask (60,988 px) is also identical to this session's independently derived catalogue (data/prepared/catalogue.npy). The upstream pin is the same for both: buffedlizard55-lab/GEMSDOE24 @ 07345ea0604953d7e, data/labels.tif and data/existing_faults.tif.
status: OPEN - and it is the single biggest cap on achievable score. Either the upstream mirror saved the same blob under both names, or the two really are the same file; neither can be distinguished without authenticated access to the DrivenData data page. Consequence: no model in this repository has ever seen a single example of the target distribution. Next session's first action should be to obtain the real labels.tif and re-run the blocked holdout against it; if the mirror is simply mislabelled, everything measured here is measuring the wrong target.

summary: The local GDR/QFaults slip_rate field's physical component semantics remain unresolved.
evidence: The local CSV has 1,126 numeric slip_rate rows, 49 distinct values, 95 missing slip_sense values, and 255 missing dip_direct values. USGS layer 21 exposes slip_rate as a string with an mm/year alias but no coded-value domain. GDR 1391 says QFaults v2 includes a field-definition text file; that archive document was not extracted here.
status: OPEN - do not state the values are confirmed vertical rates, total fault-plane rates, category midpoints, or authenticated slip estimates. Stage 1 reports both rate conventions and unknown-sense fallbacks as assumptions.

summary: Earlier metric notes overgeneralized c > 0.2·DTI as a universal marginal-pixel rule and described TP+FP as raw emitted mass.
evidence: The official weighted definition gives the general condition c·(1−0.2·DTI) > 0.2·DTI·f for weighted changes c=ΔTP and f=ΔFP. The simpler c>0.2·DTI applies only when c+f=1. See src/gems51/metric.py and tests/test_metric.py.
status: RESOLVED - metric documentation, tests, README and the generated site now state the exact condition and distinguish weighted cost from raw pixel count.

The matched addition keeps H-D and adds two intersection channels: evidence/holdout_H_G_plus_H_D.json vs data/holdout_H_D.json; same six block truth counts and sizes. Matched proxy DTI delta -0.000606262, 3/6 folds higher; AUC delta -0.002999393. Visible-catalogue proxy only.
